I am old now and my back is not strong like before, so I cannot carry heavy bags of chemical fertilizer from the market. I will plant the maize seed I kept from last year's harvest with cowpea intercropped as we always do, and spread some cow dung from my son's animals because the soil here in the North East is tired. My children and grandchildren will help with clearing, planting, weeding, and harvesting since I have no money to pay hired workers, and we will wait for the rains because there is no river or pump nearby to irrigate this land.
